LESSON: READING 4.2.1 INTENSIVE READING

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.2: Reading 4.2.1 Intensive Reading
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 4.2.1 Intensive Reading, part of Strand 4 in Grade 8 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why should one read for main ideas? 2. How can you improve your reading?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

• Learning to learn: It is enhanced as the learner shares what they have learnt while completing the mind map.

• Digital literacy: It is achieved as the learner manipulates digital devices when searching online and watching appropriate

video clips on the selected reading strategies.

Unity: It is enhanced as the learner collaborates with peers to complete the mind map.
